title: Claude and roblox animations
author: Mikey3277
selftext:
Hi guys,

  
I have a question about animations in roblox studio. I connected claude to the blender MCP and I'm under the impression claude can't actually animate. He animates in code and when i tried using the blender MCP to animate he just used it as a refrence to still animate with code.

  
Now my question is wether that is true? Is there anything I can connect claude to, to help with animations? For example a sword swing, fist punches or even a spell caster orb swing. Now if I CAN'T go the AI route with animations do you guys have any resources for animation packs I could purchase? I also struggled finding those.

  
Thank you all so much for your help
